items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Had Billy (inaudible) and all those guys with him, you know.

ctx.x: He say, "Yeah, that's an idea." And I just let it go at that.
Next time I knew it, he had -- Louie had Kyle got rid of the big band. Had Billy (inaudible) and all those guys with him, you know.
Well eventually, you went out on your own, had your own band. Did you start out having a small band, or did you try to have a larger band?
